+// Tiles are read once per block and broadcast from shared memory to targets.
+// Small rank-local partitions use several lanes per target to expose enough
+// independent square roots/divisions to occupy the GPU. The owning lane still
+// accumulates contributions in ascending j order, without a reordered reduction.
+// Separate old/new position arrays allow force, velocity, and position updates
+// to be fused without exposing updated positions to any force calculation.
+template <int LANES>
+__global__ void advanceBodies(const double3* __restrict__ positions,
+                              double3* __restrict__ nextPositions,
+                              double3* __restrict__ velocities,
+                              int n, int first, int count) {
+    __shared__ double sx[TILE], sy[TILE], sz[TILE];
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x % LANES;
+    const int local = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * (TILE / LANES) + threadIdx.x / LANES;
+    const bool active = local < count;
+    double3 position = make_double3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
+    if (active) position = positions[first + local];
+    double fx = 0.0, fy = 0.0, fz = 0.0;
+
+    for (size_t base = 0; base < static_cast<size_t>(n); base += TILE) {
+        const size_t source = base + threadIdx.x;
+        if (source < static_cast<size_t>(n)) {
+            const double3 p = positions[source];
+            sx[threadIdx.x] = p.x;
+            sy[threadIdx.x] = p.y;
+            sz[threadIdx.x] = p.z;
         }
+        __syncthreads();
+        const int length = static_cast<int>(min(static_cast<size_t>(TILE), static_cast<size_t>(n) - base));
+        if (active) {
+            #pragma unroll 4
+            for (int j = 0; j < length; j += LANES) {
+                double cx = 0.0, cy = 0.0, cz = 0.0;
+                if (j + lane < length) {
+                    const double dx = sx[j + lane] - position.x;
+                    const double dy = sy[j + lane] - position.y;
+                    const double dz = sz[j + lane] - position.z;
+                    const double distanceSquared = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
+                    const double inverseDistance = 1.0 / sqrt(distanceSquared);
+                    const double inverseCube = inverseDistance * inverseDistance * inverseDistance;
+                    cx = dx * inverseCube;
+                    cy = dy * inverseCube;
+                    cz = dz * inverseCube;
+                }
+                if constexpr (LANES == 1) {
+                    fx += cx;
+                    fy += cy;
+                    fz += cz;
+                } else {
+                    // Only this complete subgroup participates in its shuffles;
+                    // the final warp can contain inactive target subgroups.
+                    const unsigned mask = (0xffffffffu >> (32 - LANES)) <<
+                                          ((threadIdx.x % 32) / LANES * LANES);
+                    #pragma unroll
+                    for (int k = 0; k < LANES; ++k) {
+                        const double x = __shfl_sync(mask, cx, k, LANES);
+                        const double y = __shfl_sync(mask, cy, k, LANES);
+                        const double z = __shfl_sync(mask, cz, k, LANES);
+                        if (lane == 0 && j + k < length) {
+                            fx += x;
+                            fy += y;
+                            fz += z;
+                        }
+                    }
+                }
+            }
+        }
+        // Inactive threads must also reach both tile barriers.
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (active && lane == 0) {
+        double3 velocity = velocities[local];
+        velocity.x += DT * fx;
+        velocity.y += DT * fy;
+        velocity.z += DT * fz;
+        velocities[local] = velocity;
+        position.x += velocity.x * DT;
+        position.y += velocity.y * DT;
+        position.z += velocity.z * DT;
+        nextPositions[first + local] = position;
     }
-    
-    return energy;

+// Tiles are read once per block and broadcast from shared memory to targets.
+// Small rank-local partitions use several lanes per target to expose enough
+// independent square roots/divisions to occupy the GPU. The owning lane still
+// accumulates contributions in ascending j order, without a reordered reduction.
+// Separate old/new position arrays allow force, velocity, and position updates
+// to be fused without exposing updated positions to any force calculation.
+template <int LANES>
+__global__ void advanceBodies(const double3* __restrict__ positions,
+                              double3* __restrict__ nextPositions,
+                              double3* __restrict__ velocities,
+                              int n, int first, int count) {
+    __shared__ double sx[TILE], sy[TILE], sz[TILE];
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x % LANES;
+    const int local = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * (TILE / LANES) + threadIdx.x / LANES;
+    const bool active = local < count;
+    double3 position = make_double3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
+    if (active) position = positions[first + local];
+    double fx = 0.0, fy = 0.0, fz = 0.0;
+
+    for (size_t base = 0; base < static_cast<size_t>(n); base += TILE) {
+        const size_t source = base + threadIdx.x;
+        if (source < static_cast<size_t>(n)) {
+            const double3 p = positions[source];
+            sx[threadIdx.x] = p.x;
+            sy[threadIdx.x] = p.y;
+            sz[threadIdx.x] = p.z;
         }
+        __syncthreads();
+        const int length = static_cast<int>(min(static_cast<size_t>(TILE), static_cast<size_t>(n) - base));
+        if (active) {
+            #pragma unroll 4
+            for (int j = 0; j < length; j += LANES) {
+                double cx = 0.0, cy = 0.0, cz = 0.0;
+                if (j + lane < length) {
+                    const double dx = sx[j + lane] - position.x;
+                    const double dy = sy[j + lane] - position.y;
+                    const double dz = sz[j + lane] - position.z;
+                    const double distanceSquared = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
+                    const double inverseDistance = 1.0 / sqrt(distanceSquared);
+                    const double inverseCube = inverseDistance * inverseDistance * inverseDistance;
+                    cx = dx * inverseCube;
+                    cy = dy * inverseCube;
+                    cz = dz * inverseCube;
+                }
+                if constexpr (LANES == 1) {
+                    fx += cx;
+                    fy += cy;
+                    fz += cz;
+                } else {
+                    // Only this complete subgroup participates in its shuffles;
+                    // the final warp can contain inactive target subgroups.
+                    const unsigned mask = (0xffffffffu >> (32 - LANES)) <<
+                                          ((threadIdx.x % 32) / LANES * LANES);
+                    #pragma unroll
+                    for (int k = 0; k < LANES; ++k) {
+                        const double x = __shfl_sync(mask, cx, k, LANES);
+                        const double y = __shfl_sync(mask, cy, k, LANES);
+                        const double z = __shfl_sync(mask, cz, k, LANES);
+                        if (lane == 0 && j + k < length) {
+                            fx += x;
+                            fy += y;
+                            fz += z;
+                        }
+                    }
+                }
+            }
+        }
+        // Inactive threads must also reach both tile barriers.
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (active && lane == 0) {
+        double3 velocity = velocities[local];
+        velocity.x += DT * fx;
+        velocity.y += DT * fy;
+        velocity.z += DT * fz;
+        velocities[local] = velocity;
+        position.x += velocity.x * DT;
+        position.y += velocity.y * DT;
+        position.z += velocity.z * DT;
+        nextPositions[first + local] = position;
     }
-

+// Tiles are read once per block and broadcast from shared memory to targets.
+// Small rank-local partitions use several lanes per target to expose enough
+// independent square roots/divisions to occupy the GPU. The owning lane still
+// accumulates contributions in ascending j order, without a reordered reduction.
+// Separate old/new position arrays allow force, velocity, and position updates
+// to be fused without exposing updated positions to any force calculation.
+template <int LANES>
+__global__ void advanceBodies(const double3* __restrict__ positions,
+                              double3* __restrict__ nextPositions,
+                              double3* __restrict__ velocities,
+                              int n, int first, int count) {
+    __shared__ double sx[TILE], sy[TILE], sz[TILE];
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x % LANES;
+    const int local = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * (TILE / LANES) + threadIdx.x / LANES;
+    const bool active = local < count;
+    double3 position = make_double3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
+    if (active) position = positions[first + local];
+    double fx = 0.0, fy = 0.0, fz = 0.0;
+
+    for (size_t base = 0; base < static_cast<size_t>(n); base += TILE) {
+        const size_t source = base + threadIdx.x;
+        if (source < static_cast<size_t>(n)) {
+            const double3 p = positions[source];
+            sx[threadIdx.x] = p.x;
+            sy[threadIdx.x] = p.y;
+            sz[threadIdx.x] = p.z;
         }
+        __syncthreads();
+        const int length = static_cast<int>(min(static_cast<size_t>(TILE), static_cast<size_t>(n) - base));
+        if (active) {
+            #pragma unroll 4
+            for (int j = 0; j < length; j += LANES) {
+                double cx = 0.0, cy = 0.0, cz = 0.0;
+                if (j + lane < length) {
+                    const double dx = sx[j + lane] - position.x;
+                    const double dy = sy[j + lane] - position.y;
+                    const double dz = sz[j + lane] - position.z;
+                    const double distanceSquared = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
+                    const double inverseDistance = 1.0 / sqrt(distanceSquared);
+                    const double inverseCube = inverseDistance * inverseDistance * inverseDistance;
+                    cx = dx * inverseCube;
+                    cy = dy * inverseCube;
+                    cz = dz * inverseCube;
+                }
+                if constexpr (LANES == 1) {
+                    fx += cx;
+                    fy += cy;
+                    fz += cz;
+                } else {
+                    // Only this complete subgroup participates in its shuffles;
+                    // the final warp can contain inactive target subgroups.
+                    const unsigned mask = (0xffffffffu >> (32 - LANES)) <<
+                                          ((threadIdx.x % 32) / LANES * LANES);
+                    #pragma unroll
+                    for (int k = 0; k < LANES; ++k) {
+                        const double x = __shfl_sync(mask, cx, k, LANES);
+                        const double y = __shfl_sync(mask, cy, k, LANES);
+                        const double z = __shfl_sync(mask, cz, k, LANES);
+                        if (lane == 0 && j + k < length) {
+                            fx += x;
+                            fy += y;
+                            fz += z;
+                        }
+                    }
+                }
+            }
+        }
+        // Inactive threads must also reach both tile barriers.
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (active && lane == 0) {
+        double3 velocity = velocities[local];
+        velocity.x += DT * fx;
+        velocity.y += DT * fy;
+        velocity.z += DT * fz;
+        velocities[local] = velocity;
+        position.x += velocity.x * DT;
+        position.y += velocity.y * DT;
+        position.z += velocity.z * DT;
+        nextPositions[first + local] = position;
     }
-    
-    return energy;
 }

codex
The first scaling measurements showed that small rank-local partitions left much of each GPU idle. I added cooperative CUDA lanes that calculate interactions concurrently while one lane accumulates them in the original order. For 4,096 bodies over 10 steps, simulation time fell from 53 ms to 35 ms on one GPU and to 13 ms on four GPUs, with identical result hashes.

+// Tiles are read once per block and broadcast from shared memory to targets.
+// Small rank-local partitions use several lanes per target to expose enough
+// independent square roots/divisions to occupy the GPU. The owning lane still
+// accumulates contributions in ascending j order, without a reordered reduction.
+// Separate old/new position arrays allow force, velocity, and position updates
+// to be fused without exposing updated positions to any force calculation.
+template <int LANES>
+__global__ void advanceBodies(const double3* __restrict__ positions,
+                              double3* __restrict__ nextPositions,
+                              double3* __restrict__ velocities,
+                              int n, int first, int count) {
+    __shared__ double sx[TILE], sy[TILE], sz[TILE];
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x % LANES;
+    const int local = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * (TILE / LANES) + threadIdx.x / LANES;
+    const bool active = local < count;
+    double3 position = make_double3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
+    if (active) position = positions[first + local];
+    double fx = 0.0, fy = 0.0, fz = 0.0;
+
+    for (size_t base = 0; base < static_cast<size_t>(n); base += TILE) {
+        const size_t source = base + threadIdx.x;
+        if (source < static_cast<size_t>(n)) {
+            const double3 p = positions[source];
+            sx[threadIdx.x] = p.x;
+            sy[threadIdx.x] = p.y;
+            sz[threadIdx.x] = p.z;
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+        const int length = static_cast<int>(min(static_cast<size_t>(TILE), static_cast<size_t>(n) - base));
+        if (active) {
+            #pragma unroll 4
+            for (int j = 0; j < length; j += LANES) {
+                double cx = 0.0, cy = 0.0, cz = 0.0;
+                if (j + lane < length) {
+                    const double dx = sx[j + lane] - position.x;
+                    const double dy = sy[j + lane] - position.y;
+                    const double dz = sz[j + lane] - position.z;
+                    const double distanceSquared = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
+                    const double inverseDistance = 1.0 / sqrt(distanceSquared);
+                    const double inverseCube = inverseDistance * inverseDistance * inverseDistance;
+                    cx = dx * inverseCube;
+                    cy = dy * inverseCube;
+                    cz = dz * inverseCube;
+                }
+                if constexpr (LANES == 1) {
+                    fx += cx;
+                    fy += cy;
+                    fz += cz;
+                } else {
+                    // Only this complete subgroup participates in its shuffles;
+                    // the final warp can contain inactive target subgroups.
+                    const unsigned mask = (0xffffffffu >> (32 - LANES)) <<
+                                          ((threadIdx.x % 32) / LANES * LANES);
+                    #pragma unroll
+                    for (int k = 0; k < LANES; ++k) {
+                        const double x = __shfl_sync(mask, cx, k, LANES);
+                        const double y = __shfl_sync(mask, cy, k, LANES);
+                        const double z = __shfl_sync(mask, cz, k, LANES);
+                        if (lane == 0 && j + k < length) {
+                            fx += x;
+                            fy += y;
+                            fz += z;
+                        }
+                    }
+                }
+            }
         }
+        // Inactive threads must also reach both tile barriers.
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (active && lane == 0) {
+        double3 velocity = velocities[local];
+        velocity.x += DT * fx;
+        velocity.y += DT * fy;
+        velocity.z += DT * fz;
+        velocities[local] = velocity;
+        position.x += velocity.x * DT;
+        position.y += velocity.y * DT;
+        position.z += velocity.z * DT;
+        nextPositions[first + local] = position;
     }

-    return energy;

+// Tiles are read once per block and broadcast from shared memory to targets.
+// Small rank-local partitions use several lanes per target to expose enough
+// independent square roots/divisions to occupy the GPU. The owning lane still
+// accumulates contributions in ascending j order, without a reordered reduction.
+// Separate old/new position arrays allow force, velocity, and position updates
+// to be fused without exposing updated positions to any force calculation.
+template <int LANES>
+__global__ void advanceBodies(const double3* __restrict__ positions,
+                              double3* __restrict__ nextPositions,
+                              double3* __restrict__ velocities,
+                              int n, int first, int count) {
+    __shared__ double sx[TILE], sy[TILE], sz[TILE];
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x % LANES;
+    const int local = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * (TILE / LANES) + threadIdx.x / LANES;
+    const bool active = local < count;
+    double3 position = make_double3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
+    if (active) position = positions[first + local];
+    double fx = 0.0, fy = 0.0, fz = 0.0;
+
+    for (size_t base = 0; base < static_cast<size_t>(n); base += TILE) {
+        const size_t source = base + threadIdx.x;
+        if (source < static_cast<size_t>(n)) {
+            const double3 p = positions[source];
+            sx[threadIdx.x] = p.x;
+            sy[threadIdx.x] = p.y;
+            sz[threadIdx.x] = p.z;
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+        const int length = static_cast<int>(min(static_cast<size_t>(TILE), static_cast<size_t>(n) - base));
+        if (active) {
+            #pragma unroll 4
+            for (int j = 0; j < length; j += LANES) {
+                double cx = 0.0, cy = 0.0, cz = 0.0;
+                if (j + lane < length) {
+                    const double dx = sx[j + lane] - position.x;
+                    const double dy = sy[j + lane] - position.y;
+                    const double dz = sz[j + lane] - position.z;
+                    const double distanceSquared = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
+                    const double inverseDistance = 1.0 / sqrt(distanceSquared);
+                    const double inverseCube = inverseDistance * inverseDistance * inverseDistance;
+                    cx = dx * inverseCube;
+                    cy = dy * inverseCube;
+                    cz = dz * inverseCube;
+                }
+                if constexpr (LANES == 1) {
+                    fx += cx;
+                    fy += cy;
+                    fz += cz;
+                } else {
+                    // Only this complete subgroup participates in its shuffles;
+                    // the final warp can contain inactive target subgroups.
+                    const unsigned mask = (0xffffffffu >> (32 - LANES)) <<
+                                          ((threadIdx.x % 32) / LANES * LANES);
+                    #pragma unroll
+                    for (int k = 0; k < LANES; ++k) {
+                        const double x = __shfl_sync(mask, cx, k, LANES);
+                        const double y = __shfl_sync(mask, cy, k, LANES);
+                        const double z = __shfl_sync(mask, cz, k, LANES);
+                        if (lane == 0 && j + k < length) {
+                            fx += x;
+                            fy += y;
+                            fz += z;
+                        }
+                    }
+                }
+            }
         }
+        // Inactive threads must also reach both tile barriers.
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (active && lane == 0) {
+        double3 velocity = velocities[local];
+        velocity.x += DT * fx;
+        velocity.y += DT * fy;
+        velocity.z += DT * fz;
+        velocities[local] = velocity;
+        position.x += velocity.x * DT;
+        position.y += velocity.y * DT;
+        position.z += velocity.z * DT;
+        nextPositions[first + local] = position;
     }
-    
-    return energy;

+__global__ void totalEnergy(const double3* __restrict__ positions,

+int validateSimulation(const double3* positions, const double3* velocities, int count) {
+    int errors = 0;
+    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(|:errors)
+    for (int i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
+        const double3 p = positions[i], v = velocities[i];
+        if (!std::isfinite(p.x) || !std::isfinite(p.y) || !std::isfinite(p.z) ||
+            !std::isfinite(v.x) || !std::isfinite(v.y) || !std::isfinite(v.z)) {
+            errors |= 1;
+        }
+        if (std::abs(p.x) > 1e6 || std::abs(p.y) > 1e6 || std::abs(p.z) > 1e6) errors |= 2;
+        if (std::abs(v.x) > 1e6 || std::abs(v.y) > 1e6 || std::abs(v.z) > 1e6) errors |= 4;
+    }
+    return errors;

+int main(int argc, char** argv) {
+    int provided = MPI_THREAD_SINGLE;
+    if (MPI_Init_thread(&argc, &argv, MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED, &provided) != MPI_SUCCESS) return 1;
+    int rank = 0, ranks = 1;
+    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);
+    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &ranks);
+    MPI_Comm_set_errhandler(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_ERRORS_RETURN);
+    try {
+        if (provided < MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED) {
+            throw std::runtime_error("MPI must provide MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED support.");
+        }
+        const int result = runSimulation(argc, argv, rank, ranks);
+        checkMPI(MPI_Finalize());
+        return result;
+    } catch (const std::exception& error) {

+// Tiles are read once per block and broadcast from shared memory to targets.
+// Small rank-local partitions use several lanes per target to expose enough
+// independent square roots/divisions to occupy the GPU. The owning lane still
+// accumulates contributions in ascending j order, without a reordered reduction.
+// Separate old/new position arrays allow force, velocity, and position updates
+// to be fused without exposing updated positions to any force calculation.
+template <int LANES>
+__global__ void advanceBodies(const double3* __restrict__ positions,
+                              double3* __restrict__ nextPositions,
+                              double3* __restrict__ velocities,
+                              int n, int first, int count) {
+    __shared__ double sx[TILE], sy[TILE], sz[TILE];
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x % LANES;
+    const int local = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * (TILE / LANES) + threadIdx.x / LANES;
+    const bool active = local < count;
+    double3 position = make_double3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
+    if (active) position = positions[first + local];
+    double fx = 0.0, fy = 0.0, fz = 0.0;
+
+    for (size_t base = 0; base < static_cast<size_t>(n); base += TILE) {
+        const size_t source = base + threadIdx.x;
+        if (source < static_cast<size_t>(n)) {
+            const double3 p = positions[source];
+            sx[threadIdx.x] = p.x;
+            sy[threadIdx.x] = p.y;
+            sz[threadIdx.x] = p.z;
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+        const int length = static_cast<int>(min(static_cast<size_t>(TILE), static_cast<size_t>(n) - base));
+        if (active) {
+            #pragma unroll 4
+            for (int j = 0; j < length; j += LANES) {
+                double cx = 0.0, cy = 0.0, cz = 0.0;
+                if (j + lane < length) {
+                    const double dx = sx[j + lane] - position.x;
+                    const double dy = sy[j + lane] - position.y;
+                    const double dz = sz[j + lane] - position.z;
+                    const double distanceSquared = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
+                    const double inverseDistance = 1.0 / sqrt(distanceSquared);
+                    const double inverseCube = inverseDistance * inverseDistance * inverseDistance;
+                    cx = dx * inverseCube;
+                    cy = dy * inverseCube;
+                    cz = dz * inverseCube;
+                }
+                if constexpr (LANES == 1) {
+                    fx += cx;
+                    fy += cy;
+                    fz += cz;
+                } else {
+                    // Only this complete subgroup participates in its shuffles;
+                    // the final warp can contain inactive target subgroups.
+                    const unsigned mask = (0xffffffffu >> (32 - LANES)) <<
+                                          ((threadIdx.x % 32) / LANES * LANES);
+                    #pragma unroll
+                    for (int k = 0; k < LANES; ++k) {
+                        const double x = __shfl_sync(mask, cx, k, LANES);
+                        const double y = __shfl_sync(mask, cy, k, LANES);
+                        const double z = __shfl_sync(mask, cz, k, LANES);
+                        if (lane == 0 && j + k < length) {
+                            fx += x;
+                            fy += y;
+                            fz += z;
+                        }
+                    }
+                }
+            }
         }
+        // Inactive threads must also reach both tile barriers.
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (active && lane == 0) {
+        double3 velocity = velocities[local];
+        velocity.x += DT * fx;
+        velocity.y += DT * fy;
+        velocity.z += DT * fz;
+        velocities[local] = velocity;
+        position.x += velocity.x * DT;
+        position.y += velocity.y * DT;
+        position.z += velocity.z * DT;
+        nextPositions[first + local] = position;
     }
-    
-    return energy;
 }

+int validateSimulation(const double3* positions, const double3* velocities, int count) {
+    int errors = 0;
+    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(|:errors)
+    for (int i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
+        const double3 p = positions[i], v = velocities[i];
+        if (!std::isfinite(p.x) || !std::isfinite(p.y) || !std::isfinite(p.z) ||
+            !std::isfinite(v.x) || !std::isfinite(v.y) || !std::isfinite(v.z)) {
+            errors |= 1;
+        }
+        if (std::abs(p.x) > 1e6 || std::abs(p.y) > 1e6 || std::abs(p.z) > 1e6) errors |= 2;
+        if (std::abs(v.x) > 1e6 || std::abs(v.y) > 1e6 || std::abs(v.z) > 1e6) errors |= 4;
+    }
+    return errors;
+}

+// Tiles are read once per block and broadcast from shared memory to targets.
+// Small rank-local partitions use several lanes per target to expose enough
+// independent square roots/divisions to occupy the GPU. The owning lane still
+// accumulates contributions in ascending j order, without a reordered reduction.
+// Separate old/new position arrays allow force, velocity, and position updates
+// to be fused without exposing updated positions to any force calculation.
+template <int LANES>
+__global__ void advanceBodies(const double3* __restrict__ positions,
+                              double3* __restrict__ nextPositions,
+                              double3* __restrict__ velocities,
+                              int n, int first, int count) {
+    __shared__ double sx[TILE], sy[TILE], sz[TILE];
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x % LANES;
+    const int local = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * (TILE / LANES) + threadIdx.x / LANES;
+    const bool active = local < count;
+    double3 position = make_double3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
+    if (active) position = positions[first + local];
+    double fx = 0.0, fy = 0.0, fz = 0.0;
+
+    for (size_t base = 0; base < static_cast<size_t>(n); base += TILE) {
+        const size_t source = base + threadIdx.x;
+        if (source < static_cast<size_t>(n)) {
+            const double3 p = positions[source];
+            sx[threadIdx.x] = p.x;
+            sy[threadIdx.x] = p.y;
+            sz[threadIdx.x] = p.z;
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+        const int length = static_cast<int>(min(static_cast<size_t>(TILE), static_cast<size_t>(n) - base));
+        if (active) {
+            #pragma unroll 4
+            for (int j = 0; j < length; j += LANES) {
+                double cx = 0.0, cy = 0.0, cz = 0.0;
+                if (j + lane < length) {
+                    const double dx = sx[j + lane] - position.x;
+                    const double dy = sy[j + lane] - position.y;
+                    const double dz = sz[j + lane] - position.z;
+                    const double distanceSquared = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
+                    const double inverseDistance = 1.0 / sqrt(distanceSquared);
+                    const double inverseCube = inverseDistance * inverseDistance * inverseDistance;
+                    cx = dx * inverseCube;
+                    cy = dy * inverseCube;
+                    cz = dz * inverseCube;
+                }
+                if constexpr (LANES == 1) {
+                    fx += cx;
+                    fy += cy;
+                    fz += cz;
+                } else {
+                    // Only this complete subgroup participates in its shuffles;
+                    // the final warp can contain inactive target subgroups.
+                    const unsigned mask = (0xffffffffu >> (32 - LANES)) <<
+                                          ((threadIdx.x % 32) / LANES * LANES);
+                    #pragma unroll
+                    for (int k = 0; k < LANES; ++k) {
+                        const double x = __shfl_sync(mask, cx, k, LANES);
+                        const double y = __shfl_sync(mask, cy, k, LANES);
+                        const double z = __shfl_sync(mask, cz, k, LANES);
+                        if (lane == 0 && j + k < length) {
+                            fx += x;
+                            fy += y;
+                            fz += z;
+                        }
+                    }
+                }
+            }
         }
+        // Inactive threads must also reach both tile barriers.
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (active && lane == 0) {
+        double3 velocity = velocities[local];
+        velocity.x += DT * fx;
+        velocity.y += DT * fy;
+        velocity.z += DT * fz;
+        velocities[local] = velocity;
+        position.x += velocity.x * DT;
+        position.y += velocity.y * DT;
+        position.z += velocity.z * DT;
+        nextPositions[first + local] = position;
     }

+// Tiles are read once per block and broadcast from shared memory to targets.
+// Small rank-local partitions use several lanes per target to expose enough
+// independent square roots/divisions to occupy the GPU. The owning lane still
+// accumulates contributions in ascending j order, without a reordered reduction.
+// Separate old/new position arrays allow force, velocity, and position updates
+// to be fused without exposing updated positions to any force calculation.
+template <int LANES>
+__global__ void advanceBodies(const double3* __restrict__ positions,
+                              double3* __restrict__ nextPositions,
+                              double3* __restrict__ velocities,
+                              int n, int first, int count) {
+    __shared__ double sx[TILE], sy[TILE], sz[TILE];
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x % LANES;
+    const int local = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * (TILE / LANES) + threadIdx.x / LANES;
+    const bool active = local < count;
+    double3 position = make_double3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
+    if (active) position = positions[first + local];
+    double fx = 0.0, fy = 0.0, fz = 0.0;
+
+    for (size_t base = 0; base < static_cast<size_t>(n); base += TILE) {
+        const size_t source = base + threadIdx.x;
+        if (source < static_cast<size_t>(n)) {
+            const double3 p = positions[source];
+            sx[threadIdx.x] = p.x;
+            sy[threadIdx.x] = p.y;
+            sz[threadIdx.x] = p.z;
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+        const int length = static_cast<int>(min(static_cast<size_t>(TILE), static_cast<size_t>(n) - base));
+        if (active) {
+            #pragma unroll 4
+            for (int j = 0; j < length; j += LANES) {
+                double cx = 0.0, cy = 0.0, cz = 0.0;
+                if (j + lane < length) {
+                    const double dx = sx[j + lane] - position.x;
+                    const double dy = sy[j + lane] - position.y;
+                    const double dz = sz[j + lane] - position.z;
+                    const double distanceSquared = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
+                    const double inverseDistance = 1.0 / sqrt(distanceSquared);
+                    const double inverseCube = inverseDistance * inverseDistance * inverseDistance;
+                    cx = dx * inverseCube;
+                    cy = dy * inverseCube;
+                    cz = dz * inverseCube;
+                }
+                if constexpr (LANES == 1) {
+                    fx += cx;
+                    fy += cy;
+                    fz += cz;
+                } else {
+                    // Only this complete subgroup participates in its shuffles;
+                    // the final warp can contain inactive target subgroups.
+                    const unsigned mask = (0xffffffffu >> (32 - LANES)) <<
+                                          ((threadIdx.x % 32) / LANES * LANES);
+                    #pragma unroll
+                    for (int k = 0; k < LANES; ++k) {
+                        const double x = __shfl_sync(mask, cx, k, LANES);
+                        const double y = __shfl_sync(mask, cy, k, LANES);
+                        const double z = __shfl_sync(mask, cz, k, LANES);
+                        if (lane == 0 && j + k < length) {
+                            fx += x;
+                            fy += y;
+                            fz += z;
+                        }
+                    }
+                }
+            }
         }
+        // Inactive threads must also reach both tile barriers.
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (active && lane == 0) {
+        double3 velocity = velocities[local];
+        velocity.x += DT * fx;
+        velocity.y += DT * fy;
+        velocity.z += DT * fz;
+        velocities[local] = velocity;
+        position.x += velocity.x * DT;
+        position.y += velocity.y * DT;
+        position.z += velocity.z * DT;
+        nextPositions[first + local] = position;
     }
-    
-    return energy;
 }

+__global__ void totalEnergy(const double3* __restrict__ positions,

+int validateSimulation(const double3* positions, const double3* velocities, int count) {
+    int errors = 0;
+    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(|:errors)
+    for (int i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
+        const double3 p = positions[i], v = velocities[i];
+        if (!std::isfinite(p.x) || !std::isfinite(p.y) || !std::isfinite(p.z) ||
+            !std::isfinite(v.x) || !std::isfinite(v.y) || !std::isfinite(v.z)) {
+            errors |= 1;
+        }
+        if (std::abs(p.x) > 1e6 || std::abs(p.y) > 1e6 || std::abs(p.z) > 1e6) errors |= 2;
+        if (std::abs(v.x) > 1e6 || std::abs(v.y) > 1e6 || std::abs(v.z) > 1e6) errors |= 4;
+    }
+    return errors;

+int main(int argc, char** argv) {
+    int provided = MPI_THREAD_SINGLE;
+    if (MPI_Init_thread(&argc, &argv, MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED, &provided) != MPI_SUCCESS) return 1;
+    int rank = 0, ranks = 1;
+    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);
+    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &ranks);
+    MPI_Comm_set_errhandler(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_ERRORS_RETURN);
+    try {
+        if (provided < MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED) {
+            throw std::runtime_error("MPI must provide MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED support.");
+        }
+        const int result = runSimulation(argc, argv, rank, ranks);
+        checkMPI(MPI_Finalize());
+        return result;
+    } catch (const std::exception& error) {
+        fprintf(stderr, "Rank %d: %s\n", rank, error.what());

+// Tiles are read once per block and broadcast from shared memory to targets.
+// Small rank-local partitions use several lanes per target to expose enough
+// independent square roots/divisions to occupy the GPU. The owning lane still
+// accumulates contributions in ascending j order, without a reordered reduction.
+// Separate old/new position arrays allow force, velocity, and position updates
+// to be fused without exposing updated positions to any force calculation.
+template <int LANES>
+__global__ void advanceBodies(const double3* __restrict__ positions,
+                              double3* __restrict__ nextPositions,
+                              double3* __restrict__ velocities,
+                              int n, int first, int count) {
+    __shared__ double sx[TILE], sy[TILE], sz[TILE];
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x % LANES;
+    const int local = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * (TILE / LANES) + threadIdx.x / LANES;
+    const bool active = local < count;
+    double3 position = make_double3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
+    if (active) position = positions[first + local];
+    double fx = 0.0, fy = 0.0, fz = 0.0;
+
+    for (size_t base = 0; base < static_cast<size_t>(n); base += TILE) {
+        const size_t source = base + threadIdx.x;
+        if (source < static_cast<size_t>(n)) {
+            const double3 p = positions[source];
+            sx[threadIdx.x] = p.x;
+            sy[threadIdx.x] = p.y;
+            sz[threadIdx.x] = p.z;
         }
+        __syncthreads();
+        const int length = static_cast<int>(min(static_cast<size_t>(TILE), static_cast<size_t>(n) - base));
+        if (active) {
+            #pragma unroll 4
+            for (int j = 0; j < length; j += LANES) {
+                double cx = 0.0, cy = 0.0, cz = 0.0;
+                if (j + lane < length) {
+                    const double dx = sx[j + lane] - position.x;
+                    const double dy = sy[j + lane] - position.y;
+                    const double dz = sz[j + lane] - position.z;
+                    const double distanceSquared = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
+                    const double inverseDistance = 1.0 / sqrt(distanceSquared);
+                    const double inverseCube = inverseDistance * inverseDistance * inverseDistance;
+                    cx = dx * inverseCube;
+                    cy = dy * inverseCube;
+                    cz = dz * inverseCube;
+                }
+                if constexpr (LANES == 1) {
+                    fx += cx;
+                    fy += cy;
+                    fz += cz;
+                } else {
+                    // Only this complete subgroup participates in its shuffles;
+                    // the final warp can contain inactive target subgroups.
+                    const unsigned mask = (0xffffffffu >> (32 - LANES)) <<
+                                          ((threadIdx.x % 32) / LANES * LANES);
+                    #pragma unroll
+                    for (int k = 0; k < LANES; ++k) {
+                        const double x = __shfl_sync(mask, cx, k, LANES);
+                        const double y = __shfl_sync(mask, cy, k, LANES);
+                        const double z = __shfl_sync(mask, cz, k, LANES);
+                        if (lane == 0 && j + k < length) {
+                            fx += x;
+                            fy += y;
+                            fz += z;
+                        }
+                    }
+                }
+            }
+        }
+        // Inactive threads must also reach both tile barriers.
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (active && lane == 0) {
+        double3 velocity = velocities[local];
+        velocity.x += DT * fx;
+        velocity.y += DT * fy;
+        velocity.z += DT * fz;
+        velocities[local] = velocity;
+        position.x += velocity.x * DT;
+        position.y += velocity.y * DT;
+        position.z += velocity.z * DT;
+        nextPositions[first + local] = position;
     }
-    
-    return energy;
 }

+// Tiles are read once per block and broadcast from shared memory to targets.
+// Small rank-local partitions use several lanes per target to expose enough
+// independent square roots/divisions to occupy the GPU. The owning lane still
+// accumulates contributions in ascending j order, without a reordered reduction.
+// Separate old/new position arrays allow force, velocity, and position updates
+// to be fused without exposing updated positions to any force calculation.
+template <int LANES>
+__global__ void advanceBodies(const double3* __restrict__ positions,
+                              double3* __restrict__ nextPositions,
+                              double3* __restrict__ velocities,
+                              int n, int first, int count) {
+    __shared__ double sx[TILE], sy[TILE], sz[TILE];
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x % LANES;
+    const int local = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * (TILE / LANES) + threadIdx.x / LANES;
+    const bool active = local < count;
+    double3 position = make_double3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
+    if (active) position = positions[first + local];
+    double fx = 0.0, fy = 0.0, fz = 0.0;
+
+    for (size_t base = 0; base < static_cast<size_t>(n); base += TILE) {
+        const size_t source = base + threadIdx.x;
+        if (source < static_cast<size_t>(n)) {
+            const double3 p = positions[source];
+            sx[threadIdx.x] = p.x;
+            sy[threadIdx.x] = p.y;
+            sz[threadIdx.x] = p.z;
         }
+        __syncthreads();
+        const int length = static_cast<int>(min(static_cast<size_t>(TILE), static_cast<size_t>(n) - base));
+        if (active) {
+            #pragma unroll 4
+            for (int j = 0; j < length; j += LANES) {
+                double cx = 0.0, cy = 0.0, cz = 0.0;
+                if (j + lane < length) {
+                    const double dx = sx[j + lane] - position.x;
+                    const double dy = sy[j + lane] - position.y;
+                    const double dz = sz[j + lane] - position.z;
+                    const double distanceSquared = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
+                    const double inverseDistance = 1.0 / sqrt(distanceSquared);
+                    const double inverseCube = inverseDistance * inverseDistance * inverseDistance;
+                    cx = dx * inverseCube;
+                    cy = dy * inverseCube;
+                    cz = dz * inverseCube;
+                }
+                if constexpr (LANES == 1) {
+                    fx += cx;
+                    fy += cy;
+                    fz += cz;
+                } else {
+                    // Only this complete subgroup participates in its shuffles;
+                    // the final warp can contain inactive target subgroups.
+                    const unsigned mask = (0xffffffffu >> (32 - LANES)) <<
+                                          ((threadIdx.x % 32) / LANES * LANES);
+                    #pragma unroll
+                    for (int k = 0; k < LANES; ++k) {
+                        const double x = __shfl_sync(mask, cx, k, LANES);
+                        const double y = __shfl_sync(mask, cy, k, LANES);
+                        const double z = __shfl_sync(mask, cz, k, LANES);
+                        if (lane == 0 && j + k < length) {
+                            fx += x;
+                            fy += y;
+                            fz += z;
+                        }
+                    }
+                }
+            }
+        }
+        // Inactive threads must also reach both tile barriers.
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (active && lane == 0) {
+        double3 velocity = velocities[local];
+        velocity.x += DT * fx;
+        velocity.y += DT * fy;
+        velocity.z += DT * fz;
+        velocities[local] = velocity;
+        position.x += velocity.x * DT;
+        position.y += velocity.y * DT;
+        position.z += velocity.z * DT;
+        nextPositions[first + local] = position;
     }

+// Tiles are read once per block and broadcast from shared memory to targets.
+// Small rank-local partitions use several lanes per target to expose enough
+// independent square roots/divisions to occupy the GPU. The owning lane still
+// accumulates contributions in ascending j order, without a reordered reduction.
+// Separate old/new position arrays allow force, velocity, and position updates
+// to be fused without exposing updated positions to any force calculation.
+template <int LANES>
+__global__ void advanceBodies(const double3* __restrict__ positions,
+                              double3* __restrict__ nextPositions,
+                              double3* __restrict__ velocities,
+                              int n, int first, int count) {
+    __shared__ double sx[TILE], sy[TILE], sz[TILE];
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x % LANES;
+    const int local = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * (TILE / LANES) + threadIdx.x / LANES;
+    const bool active = local < count;
+    double3 position = make_double3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
+    if (active) position = positions[first + local];
+    double fx = 0.0, fy = 0.0, fz = 0.0;
+
+    for (size_t base = 0; base < static_cast<size_t>(n); base += TILE) {
+        const size_t source = base + threadIdx.x;
+        if (source < static_cast<size_t>(n)) {
+            const double3 p = positions[source];
+            sx[threadIdx.x] = p.x;
+            sy[threadIdx.x] = p.y;
+            sz[threadIdx.x] = p.z;
         }
+        __syncthreads();
+        const int length = static_cast<int>(min(static_cast<size_t>(TILE), static_cast<size_t>(n) - base));
+        if (active) {
+            #pragma unroll 4
+            for (int j = 0; j < length; j += LANES) {
+                double cx = 0.0, cy = 0.0, cz = 0.0;
+                if (j + lane < length) {
+                    const double dx = sx[j + lane] - position.x;
+                    const double dy = sy[j + lane] - position.y;
+                    const double dz = sz[j + lane] - position.z;
+                    const double distanceSquared = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
+                    const double inverseDistance = 1.0 / sqrt(distanceSquared);
+                    const double inverseCube = inverseDistance * inverseDistance * inverseDistance;
+                    cx = dx * inverseCube;
+                    cy = dy * inverseCube;
+                    cz = dz * inverseCube;
+                }
+                if constexpr (LANES == 1) {
+                    fx += cx;
+                    fy += cy;
+                    fz += cz;
+                } else {
+                    // Only this complete subgroup participates in its shuffles;
+                    // the final warp can contain inactive target subgroups.
+                    const unsigned mask = (0xffffffffu >> (32 - LANES)) <<
+                                          ((threadIdx.x % 32) / LANES * LANES);
+                    #pragma unroll
+                    for (int k = 0; k < LANES; ++k) {
+                        const double x = __shfl_sync(mask, cx, k, LANES);
+                        const double y = __shfl_sync(mask, cy, k, LANES);
+                        const double z = __shfl_sync(mask, cz, k, LANES);
+                        if (lane == 0 && j + k < length) {
+                            fx += x;
+                            fy += y;
+                            fz += z;
+                        }
+                    }
+                }
+            }
+        }
+        // Inactive threads must also reach both tile barriers.
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (active && lane == 0) {
+        double3 velocity = velocities[local];
+        velocity.x += DT * fx;
+        velocity.y += DT * fy;
+        velocity.z += DT * fz;
+        velocities[local] = velocity;
+        position.x += velocity.x * DT;
+        position.y += velocity.y * DT;
+        position.z += velocity.z * DT;
+        nextPositions[first + local] = position;
     }
-    
-    return energy;

+// Tiles are read once per block and broadcast from shared memory to targets.
+// Small rank-local partitions use several lanes per target to expose enough
+// independent square roots/divisions to occupy the GPU. The owning lane still
+// accumulates contributions in ascending j order, without a reordered reduction.
+// Separate old/new position arrays allow force, velocity, and position updates
+// to be fused without exposing updated positions to any force calculation.
+template <int LANES>
+__global__ void advanceBodies(const double3* __restrict__ positions,
+                              double3* __restrict__ nextPositions,
+                              double3* __restrict__ velocities,
+                              int n, int first, int count) {
+    __shared__ double sx[TILE], sy[TILE], sz[TILE];
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x % LANES;
+    const int local = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * (TILE / LANES) + threadIdx.x / LANES;
+    const bool active = local < count;
+    double3 position = make_double3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
+    if (active) position = positions[first + local];
+    double fx = 0.0, fy = 0.0, fz = 0.0;
+
+    for (size_t base = 0; base < static_cast<size_t>(n); base += TILE) {
+        const size_t source = base + threadIdx.x;
+        if (source < static_cast<size_t>(n)) {
+            const double3 p = positions[source];
+            sx[threadIdx.x] = p.x;
+            sy[threadIdx.x] = p.y;
+            sz[threadIdx.x] = p.z;
         }
+        __syncthreads();
+        const int length = static_cast<int>(min(static_cast<size_t>(TILE), static_cast<size_t>(n) - base));
+        if (active) {
+            #pragma unroll 4
+            for (int j = 0; j < length; j += LANES) {
+                double cx = 0.0, cy = 0.0, cz = 0.0;
+                if (j + lane < length) {
+                    const double dx = sx[j + lane] - position.x;
+                    const double dy = sy[j + lane] - position.y;
+                    const double dz = sz[j + lane] - position.z;
+                    const double distanceSquared = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
+                    const double inverseDistance = 1.0 / sqrt(distanceSquared);
+                    const double inverseCube = inverseDistance * inverseDistance * inverseDistance;
+                    cx = dx * inverseCube;
+                    cy = dy * inverseCube;
+                    cz = dz * inverseCube;
+                }
+                if constexpr (LANES == 1) {
+                    fx += cx;
+                    fy += cy;
+                    fz += cz;
+                } else {
+                    // Only this complete subgroup participates in its shuffles;
+                    // the final warp can contain inactive target subgroups.
+                    const unsigned mask = (0xffffffffu >> (32 - LANES)) <<
+                                          ((threadIdx.x % 32) / LANES * LANES);
+                    #pragma unroll
+                    for (int k = 0; k < LANES; ++k) {
+                        const double x = __shfl_sync(mask, cx, k, LANES);
+                        const double y = __shfl_sync(mask, cy, k, LANES);
+                        const double z = __shfl_sync(mask, cz, k, LANES);
+                        if (lane == 0 && j + k < length) {
+                            fx += x;
+                            fy += y;
+                            fz += z;
+                        }
+                    }
+                }
+            }
+        }
+        // Inactive threads must also reach both tile barriers.
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (active && lane == 0) {
+        double3 velocity = velocities[local];
+        velocity.x += DT * fx;
+        velocity.y += DT * fy;
+        velocity.z += DT * fz;
+        velocities[local] = velocity;
+        position.x += velocity.x * DT;
+        position.y += velocity.y * DT;
+        position.z += velocity.z * DT;
+        nextPositions[first + local] = position;
     }
-    
-    return energy;

+// Tiles are read once per block and broadcast from shared memory to targets.
+// Small rank-local partitions use several lanes per target to expose enough
+// independent square roots/divisions to occupy the GPU. The owning lane still
+// accumulates contributions in ascending j order, without a reordered reduction.
+// Separate old/new position arrays allow force, velocity, and position updates
+// to be fused without exposing updated positions to any force calculation.
+template <int LANES>
+__global__ void advanceBodies(const double3* __restrict__ positions,
+                              double3* __restrict__ nextPositions,
+                              double3* __restrict__ velocities,
+                              int n, int first, int count) {
+    __shared__ double sx[TILE], sy[TILE], sz[TILE];
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x % LANES;
+    const int local = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * (TILE / LANES) + threadIdx.x / LANES;
+    const bool active = local < count;
+    double3 position = make_double3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
+    if (active) position = positions[first + local];
+    double fx = 0.0, fy = 0.0, fz = 0.0;
+
+    for (size_t base = 0; base < static_cast<size_t>(n); base += TILE) {
+        const size_t source = base + threadIdx.x;
+        if (source < static_cast<size_t>(n)) {
+            const double3 p = positions[source];
+            sx[threadIdx.x] = p.x;
+            sy[threadIdx.x] = p.y;
+            sz[threadIdx.x] = p.z;
         }
+        __syncthreads();
+        const int length = static_cast<int>(min(static_cast<size_t>(TILE), static_cast<size_t>(n) - base));
+        if (active) {
+            #pragma unroll 4
+            for (int j = 0; j < length; j += LANES) {
+                double cx = 0.0, cy = 0.0, cz = 0.0;
+                if (j + lane < length) {
+                    const double dx = sx[j + lane] - position.x;
+                    const double dy = sy[j + lane] - position.y;
+                    const double dz = sz[j + lane] - position.z;
+                    const double distanceSquared = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
+                    const double inverseDistance = 1.0 / sqrt(distanceSquared);
+                    const double inverseCube = inverseDistance * inverseDistance * inverseDistance;
+                    cx = dx * inverseCube;
+                    cy = dy * inverseCube;
+                    cz = dz * inverseCube;
+                }
+                if constexpr (LANES == 1) {
+                    fx += cx;
+                    fy += cy;
+                    fz += cz;
+                } else {
+                    // Only this complete subgroup participates in its shuffles;
+                    // the final warp can contain inactive target subgroups.
+                    const unsigned mask = (0xffffffffu >> (32 - LANES)) <<
+                                          ((threadIdx.x % 32) / LANES * LANES);
+                    #pragma unroll
+                    for (int k = 0; k < LANES; ++k) {
+                        const double x = __shfl_sync(mask, cx, k, LANES);
+                        const double y = __shfl_sync(mask, cy, k, LANES);
+                        const double z = __shfl_sync(mask, cz, k, LANES);
+                        if (lane == 0 && j + k < length) {
+                            fx += x;
+                            fy += y;
+                            fz += z;
+                        }
+                    }
+                }
+            }
+        }
+        // Inactive threads must also reach both tile barriers.
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (active && lane == 0) {
+        double3 velocity = velocities[local];
+        velocity.x += DT * fx;
+        velocity.y += DT * fy;
+        velocity.z += DT * fz;
+        velocities[local] = velocity;
+        position.x += velocity.x * DT;
+        position.y += velocity.y * DT;
+        position.z += velocity.z * DT;
+        nextPositions[first + local] = position;
     }
-

+int main(int argc, char** argv) {

+// Tiles are read once per block and broadcast from shared memory to targets.
+// Small rank-local partitions use several lanes per target to expose enough
+// independent square roots/divisions to occupy the GPU. The owning lane still
+// accumulates contributions in ascending j order, without a reordered reduction.
+// Separate old/new position arrays allow force, velocity, and position updates
+// to be fused without exposing updated positions to any force calculation.
+template <int LANES>
+__global__ void advanceBodies(const double3* __restrict__ positions,
+                              double3* __restrict__ nextPositions,
+                              double3* __restrict__ velocities,
+                              int n, int first, int count) {
+    __shared__ double sx[TILE], sy[TILE], sz[TILE];
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x % LANES;
+    const int local = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * (TILE / LANES) + threadIdx.x / LANES;
+    const bool active = local < count;
+    double3 position = make_double3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
+    if (active) position = positions[first + local];
+    double fx = 0.0, fy = 0.0, fz = 0.0;
+
+    for (size_t base = 0; base < static_cast<size_t>(n); base += TILE) {
+        const size_t source = base + threadIdx.x;
+        if (source < static_cast<size_t>(n)) {
+            const double3 p = positions[source];
+            sx[threadIdx.x] = p.x;
+            sy[threadIdx.x] = p.y;
+            sz[threadIdx.x] = p.z;
         }
+        __syncthreads();
+        const int length = static_cast<int>(min(static_cast<size_t>(TILE), static_cast<size_t>(n) - base));
+        if (active) {
+            #pragma unroll 4
+            for (int j = 0; j < length; j += LANES) {
+                double cx = 0.0, cy = 0.0, cz = 0.0;
+                if (j + lane < length) {
+                    const double dx = sx[j + lane] - position.x;
+                    const double dy = sy[j + lane] - position.y;
+                    const double dz = sz[j + lane] - position.z;
+                    const double distanceSquared = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
+                    const double inverseDistance = 1.0 / sqrt(distanceSquared);
+                    const double inverseCube = inverseDistance * inverseDistance * inverseDistance;
+                    cx = dx * inverseCube;
+                    cy = dy * inverseCube;
+                    cz = dz * inverseCube;
+                }
+                if constexpr (LANES == 1) {
+                    fx += cx;
+                    fy += cy;
+                    fz += cz;
+                } else {
+                    // Only this complete subgroup participates in its shuffles;
+                    // the final warp can contain inactive target subgroups.
+                    const unsigned mask = (0xffffffffu >> (32 - LANES)) <<
+                                          ((threadIdx.x % 32) / LANES * LANES);
+                    #pragma unroll
+                    for (int k = 0; k < LANES; ++k) {
+                        const double x = __shfl_sync(mask, cx, k, LANES);
+                        const double y = __shfl_sync(mask, cy, k, LANES);
+                        const double z = __shfl_sync(mask, cz, k, LANES);
+                        if (lane == 0 && j + k < length) {
+                            fx += x;
+                            fy += y;
+                            fz += z;
+                        }
+                    }
+                }
+            }
+        }
+        // Inactive threads must also reach both tile barriers.
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (active && lane == 0) {
+        double3 velocity = velocities[local];
+        velocity.x += DT * fx;
+        velocity.y += DT * fy;
+        velocity.z += DT * fz;
+        velocities[local] = velocity;
+        position.x += velocity.x * DT;
+        position.y += velocity.y * DT;
+        position.z += velocity.z * DT;
+        nextPositions[first + local] = position;
     }
-    
-    return energy;
 }

+// Tiles are read once per block and broadcast from shared memory to targets.
+// Small rank-local partitions use several lanes per target to expose enough
+// independent square roots/divisions to occupy the GPU. The owning lane still
+// accumulates contributions in ascending j order, without a reordered reduction.
+// Separate old/new position arrays allow force, velocity, and position updates
+// to be fused without exposing updated positions to any force calculation.
+template <int LANES>
+__global__ void advanceBodies(const double3* __restrict__ positions,
+                              double3* __restrict__ nextPositions,
+                              double3* __restrict__ velocities,
+                              int n, int first, int count) {
+    __shared__ double sx[TILE], sy[TILE], sz[TILE];
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x % LANES;
+    const int local = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * (TILE / LANES) + threadIdx.x / LANES;
+    const bool active = local < count;
+    double3 position = make_double3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
+    if (active) position = positions[first + local];
+    double fx = 0.0, fy = 0.0, fz = 0.0;
+
+    for (size_t base = 0; base < static_cast<size_t>(n); base += TILE) {
+        const size_t source = base + threadIdx.x;
+        if (source < static_cast<size_t>(n)) {
+            const double3 p = positions[source];
+            sx[threadIdx.x] = p.x;
+            sy[threadIdx.x] = p.y;
+            sz[threadIdx.x] = p.z;
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+        const int length = static_cast<int>(min(static_cast<size_t>(TILE), static_cast<size_t>(n) - base));
+        if (active) {
+            #pragma unroll 4
+            for (int j = 0; j < length; j += LANES) {
+                double cx = 0.0, cy = 0.0, cz = 0.0;
+                if (j + lane < length) {
+                    const double dx = sx[j + lane] - position.x;
+                    const double dy = sy[j + lane] - position.y;
+                    const double dz = sz[j + lane] - position.z;
+                    const double distanceSquared = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
+                    const double inverseDistance = 1.0 / sqrt(distanceSquared);
+                    const double inverseCube = inverseDistance * inverseDistance * inverseDistance;
+                    cx = dx * inverseCube;
+                    cy = dy * inverseCube;
+                    cz = dz * inverseCube;
+                }
+                if constexpr (LANES == 1) {
+                    fx += cx;
+                    fy += cy;
+                    fz += cz;
+                } else {
+                    // Only this complete subgroup participates in its shuffles;
+                    // the final warp can contain inactive target subgroups.
+                    const unsigned mask = (0xffffffffu >> (32 - LANES)) <<
+                                          ((threadIdx.x % 32) / LANES * LANES);
+                    #pragma unroll
+                    for (int k = 0; k < LANES; ++k) {
+                        const double x = __shfl_sync(mask, cx, k, LANES);
+                        const double y = __shfl_sync(mask, cy, k, LANES);
+                        const double z = __shfl_sync(mask, cz, k, LANES);
+                        if (lane == 0 && j + k < length) {
+                            fx += x;
+                            fy += y;
+                            fz += z;
+                        }
+                    }
+                }
+            }
         }
+        // Inactive threads must also reach both tile barriers.
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (active && lane == 0) {
+        double3 velocity = velocities[local];
+        velocity.x += DT * fx;
+        velocity.y += DT * fy;
+        velocity.z += DT * fz;
+        velocities[local] = velocity;
+        position.x += velocity.x * DT;
+        position.y += velocity.y * DT;
+        position.z += velocity.z * DT;
+        nextPositions[first + local] = position;
     }
-    
-    return energy;

+int validateSimulation(const double3* positions, const double3* velocities, int count) {

+// Tiles are read once per block and broadcast from shared memory to targets.
+// Small rank-local partitions use several lanes per target to expose enough
+// independent square roots/divisions to occupy the GPU. The owning lane still
+// accumulates contributions in ascending j order, without a reordered reduction.
+// Separate old/new position arrays allow force, velocity, and position updates
+// to be fused without exposing updated positions to any force calculation.
+template <int LANES>
+__global__ void advanceBodies(const double3* __restrict__ positions,
+                              double3* __restrict__ nextPositions,
+                              double3* __restrict__ velocities,
+                              int n, int first, int count) {
+    __shared__ double sx[TILE], sy[TILE], sz[TILE];
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x % LANES;
+    const int local = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * (TILE / LANES) + threadIdx.x / LANES;
+    const bool active = local < count;
+    double3 position = make_double3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
+    if (active) position = positions[first + local];
+    double fx = 0.0, fy = 0.0, fz = 0.0;
+
+    for (size_t base = 0; base < static_cast<size_t>(n); base += TILE) {
+        const size_t source = base + threadIdx.x;
+        if (source < static_cast<size_t>(n)) {
+            const double3 p = positions[source];
+            sx[threadIdx.x] = p.x;
+            sy[threadIdx.x] = p.y;
+            sz[threadIdx.x] = p.z;
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+        const int length = static_cast<int>(min(static_cast<size_t>(TILE), static_cast<size_t>(n) - base));
+        if (active) {
+            #pragma unroll 4
+            for (int j = 0; j < length; j += LANES) {
+                double cx = 0.0, cy = 0.0, cz = 0.0;
+                if (j + lane < length) {
+                    const double dx = sx[j + lane] - position.x;
+                    const double dy = sy[j + lane] - position.y;
+                    const double dz = sz[j + lane] - position.z;
+                    const double distanceSquared = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
+                    const double inverseDistance = 1.0 / sqrt(distanceSquared);
+                    const double inverseCube = inverseDistance * inverseDistance * inverseDistance;
+                    cx = dx * inverseCube;
+                    cy = dy * inverseCube;
+                    cz = dz * inverseCube;
+                }
+                if constexpr (LANES == 1) {
+                    fx += cx;
+                    fy += cy;
+                    fz += cz;
+                } else {
+                    // Only this complete subgroup participates in its shuffles;
+                    // the final warp can contain inactive target subgroups.
+                    const unsigned mask = (0xffffffffu >> (32 - LANES)) <<
+                                          ((threadIdx.x % 32) / LANES * LANES);
+                    #pragma unroll
+                    for (int k = 0; k < LANES; ++k) {
+                        const double x = __shfl_sync(mask, cx, k, LANES);
+                        const double y = __shfl_sync(mask, cy, k, LANES);
+                        const double z = __shfl_sync(mask, cz, k, LANES);
+                        if (lane == 0 && j + k < length) {
+                            fx += x;
+                            fy += y;
+                            fz += z;
+                        }
+                    }
+                }
+            }
         }
+        // Inactive threads must also reach both tile barriers.
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (active && lane == 0) {
+        double3 velocity = velocities[local];
+        velocity.x += DT * fx;
+        velocity.y += DT * fy;
+        velocity.z += DT * fz;
+        velocities[local] = velocity;
+        position.x += velocity.x * DT;
+        position.y += velocity.y * DT;
+        position.z += velocity.z * DT;
+        nextPositions[first + local] = position;
     }
-    
-    return energy;

+int validateSimulation(const double3* positions, const double3* velocities, int count) {
+    int errors = 0;
+    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(|:errors)
+    for (int i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
+        const double3 p = positions[i], v = velocities[i];
+        if (!std::isfinite(p.x) || !std::isfinite(p.y) || !std::isfinite(p.z) ||
+            !std::isfinite(v.x) || !std::isfinite(v.y) || !std::isfinite(v.z)) {
+            errors |= 1;
+        }
+        if (std::abs(p.x) > 1e6 || std::abs(p.y) > 1e6 || std::abs(p.z) > 1e6) errors |= 2;
+        if (std::abs(v.x) > 1e6 || std::abs(v.y) > 1e6 || std::abs(v.z) > 1e6) errors |= 4;
+    }
+    return errors;

Verified serial-reference agreement on up to four GPUs, including edge cases. CUDA memory, race, and synchronization checks passed.

+// Tiles are read once per block and broadcast from shared memory to targets.
+// Small rank-local partitions use several lanes per target to expose enough
+// independent square roots/divisions to occupy the GPU. The owning lane still
+// accumulates contributions in ascending j order, without a reordered reduction.
+// Separate old/new position arrays allow force, velocity, and position updates
+// to be fused without exposing updated positions to any force calculation.
+template <int LANES>
+__global__ void advanceBodies(const double3* __restrict__ positions,
+                              double3* __restrict__ nextPositions,
+                              double3* __restrict__ velocities,
+                              int n, int first, int count) {
+    __shared__ double sx[TILE], sy[TILE], sz[TILE];
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x % LANES;
+    const int local = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * (TILE / LANES) + threadIdx.x / LANES;
+    const bool active = local < count;
+    double3 position = make_double3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
+    if (active) position = positions[first + local];
+    double fx = 0.0, fy = 0.0, fz = 0.0;
+
+    for (size_t base = 0; base < static_cast<size_t>(n); base += TILE) {
+        const size_t source = base + threadIdx.x;
+        if (source < static_cast<size_t>(n)) {
+            const double3 p = positions[source];
+            sx[threadIdx.x] = p.x;
+            sy[threadIdx.x] = p.y;
+            sz[threadIdx.x] = p.z;
+        }
+        __syncthreads();
+        const int length = static_cast<int>(min(static_cast<size_t>(TILE), static_cast<size_t>(n) - base));
+        if (active) {
+            #pragma unroll 4
+            for (int j = 0; j < length; j += LANES) {
+                double cx = 0.0, cy = 0.0, cz = 0.0;
+                if (j + lane < length) {
+                    const double dx = sx[j + lane] - position.x;
+                    const double dy = sy[j + lane] - position.y;
+                    const double dz = sz[j + lane] - position.z;
+                    const double distanceSquared = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
+                    const double inverseDistance = 1.0 / sqrt(distanceSquared);
+                    const double inverseCube = inverseDistance * inverseDistance * inverseDistance;
+                    cx = dx * inverseCube;
+                    cy = dy * inverseCube;
+                    cz = dz * inverseCube;
+                }
+                if constexpr (LANES == 1) {
+                    fx += cx;
+                    fy += cy;
+                    fz += cz;
+                } else {
+                    // Only this complete subgroup participates in its shuffles;
+                    // the final warp can contain inactive target subgroups.
+                    const unsigned mask = (0xffffffffu >> (32 - LANES)) <<
+                                          ((threadIdx.x % 32) / LANES * LANES);
+                    #pragma unroll
+                    for (int k = 0; k < LANES; ++k) {
+                        const double x = __shfl_sync(mask, cx, k, LANES);
+                        const double y = __shfl_sync(mask, cy, k, LANES);
+                        const double z = __shfl_sync(mask, cz, k, LANES);
+                        if (lane == 0 && j + k < length) {
+                            fx += x;
+                            fy += y;
+                            fz += z;
+                        }
+                    }
+                }
+            }
         }
+        // Inactive threads must also reach both tile barriers.
+        __syncthreads();
+    }
+    if (active && lane == 0) {
+        double3 velocity = velocities[local];
+        velocity.x += DT * fx;
+        velocity.y += DT * fy;
+        velocity.z += DT * fz;
+        velocities[local] = velocity;
+        position.x += velocity.x * DT;
+        position.y += velocity.y * DT;
+        position.z += velocity.z * DT;
+        nextPositions[first + local] = position;
     }
-    
-    return energy;
 }

+int validateSimulation(const double3* positions, const double3* velocities, int count) {
+    int errors = 0;
+    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(|:errors)
+    for (int i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
+        const double3 p = positions[i], v = velocities[i];
+        if (!std::isfinite(p.x) || !std::isfinite(p.y) || !std::isfinite(p.z) ||
+            !std::isfinite(v.x) || !std::isfinite(v.y) || !std::isfinite(v.z)) {
+            errors |= 1;
+        }
+        if (std::abs(p.x) > 1e6 || std::abs(p.y) > 1e6 || std::abs(p.z) > 1e6) errors |= 2;
+        if (std::abs(v.x) > 1e6 || std::abs(v.y) > 1e6 || std::abs(v.z) > 1e6) errors |= 4;
+    }
+    return errors;
+}

+        if (provided < MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED) {
+            throw std::runtime_error("MPI must provide MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED support.");
+        }
+        const int result = runSimulation(argc, argv, rank, ranks);
+        checkMPI(MPI_Finalize());
+        return result;
+    } catch (const std::exception& error) {
+        fprintf(stderr, "Rank %d: %s\n", rank, error.what());
+        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);
+        return 1;
+    }
+}
